title: Evidence-Bounded Contextual Bibliometrics: Task-Specific Validation, Automation Boundaries, and Claims Governance in a Meadows 1972 Stress Test
description: Paper 1 release package for a methods-focused contextual bibliometrics study. The release contains the Scientometrics-targeted manuscript, final Paper 1 figures and tables, frozen v2.0 methodology artifacts, validation summaries, selected final validation records, and reproducibility documentation. Source PDFs are excluded from the minimum release package pending rights review.
